raw_segments.text: Menenius. Oh, he's a limb that has but a disease mortal to cut it off, to cure it easy.
What has he done to roam that's worthy death? Killing our enemies, the blood he hath lost.
Which I dare vouch is more than that he hath by many an ounce. He dropped it for his country,
and what is left to lose it by his country were to us all that dot and suffer it a brand
